fields.title: Humidity criterion and service
fields.finding: 5% of cold saturation is a design target; h=2 shortens the nominal first interval. Initial fill is assumed dry.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure the complete internal dewpoint distribution and establish an operating interval including uncertainty.

claim: 5% of cold saturation is a design target; h=2 shortens the nominal first interval. Initial fill is assumed dry. | Humidity criterion and service
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying.
